name: Emami Ltd
title: Emami Ltd-$ - 531162 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue down 4% and EBITDA down 15% on weak summer and Middle East disruption, though gross margin rose 250bps to 68.4% and receivables fell over INR100 crores.

triggers.label: Receivables cut by over INR100 crores
triggers.quote: we consciously reduced our receivables by over INR100 crores during the year, a 10 days improvement in the working capital cycle

triggers.label: Ex-summer domestic growth 11% in Q4
triggers.quote: Our domestic business ex of summer portfolio demonstrated healthy resilience, growing strongly in double digits at 11% in Q4 '26

triggers.label: Talc summer portfolio down 40%
triggers.quote: The summer portfolio was the principal drag declining by 22% with talcum powders alone declining by 40%.

triggers.label: International Q1 growth close to single digit
triggers.quote: quarter 1 should also remain close to single-digit growth types only

guidance.quote: from second quarter, we should be able to deliver good double-digit growth.
The idea going forward across the portfolio is to sustain growth at 30% year -on-year while improving the bottom line as well.

guidance.value: increase absolute EBITDA by about INR15 crores
guidance.quote: This year, the intent is to increase the absolute EBITDA by about INR15 crores.

red_flags.label: Talc/summer volume collapse ~INR100cr lost
red_flags.quote: We lost almost INR100 crores of business in talc last year.

red_flags.label: Ad spend ~19.6% of sales, rising with new ventures

evasions.quote: I can't predict for BoroPlus for now.

evasions.topic: Copra price impact on hair oil
evasions.quote: I don't track copra prices, very honestly, because we don't use that.
Let's wait and see, Harit, still there is some pressure as far as the input costs are concerned
